en: Changed MCP servers configured under the name `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` to list no skills or prompts (their tools still work); rename the server in your MCP configuration to list them again
zh: 变更以 `anthropic-skills` 或 `claude-ai` 名称配置的 MCP servers，使其不列出任何 skills 或 prompts（其工具仍可用）；在 MCP 配置中重命名该 server 即可重新列出
